name: Reaction of Iron Nails with Copper Sulphate
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT textbook portal; Class 10 chemical reactions activity page to verify
educational_goal: Observe a displacement reaction and connect visible changes to relative reactivity of metals.

scenes.description: A clean iron nail is suspended in a transparent test tube containing blue copper sulphate solution on a school laboratory bench.
scenes.image_url: PLACEHOLDER: add a license-reviewed iron-copper sulphate photo

steps.description: Clean an iron nail with sandpaper and place it in a test tube of blue copper sulphate solution.
steps.observation: The nail is initially metallic gray and the solution is blue.
steps.key_visual: The nail is initially metallic gray and the solution is blue.

scenes.description: A clean iron nail is suspended in a transparent test tube containing blue copper sulphate solution on a school laboratory bench.

steps.description: Leave the nail immersed without shaking for an observation period.
steps.observation: A reddish-brown coating begins forming on the nail.
steps.key_visual: A reddish-brown coating begins forming on the nail.

steps.description: Remove the nail and compare the solution color with a fresh sample.
steps.observation: The solution becomes less blue as iron displaces copper.
steps.key_visual: The solution becomes less blue as iron displaces copper.

scenes.description: A clean iron nail is suspended in a transparent test tube containing blue copper sulphate solution on a school laboratory bench.

steps.description: Write the word equation for the displacement reaction.
steps.observation: Iron and copper sulphate produce iron sulphate and copper.
steps.key_visual: Iron and copper sulphate produce iron sulphate and copper.
